title: Tagarupalya
desc: A villager arranges his daughter's marriage to a city boy and plans a special sacrifice to thank the gods. But during the ritual, unexpected troubles shake up their world.

title: Housemates
desc: Newly married Karthik and Anu buy an apartment and begin life there. Strange happenings lead them to fear ghosts, but they soon discover the truth.

title: The Mummy
desc: Adventurer Rick O'Connell and Egyptologist Evelyn, along with a bunch of archaeologists, inadvertently wake up a bedeviled mummy during an archaeological excavation at the ancient city of Hamunaptra.

title: Bade Miyan Chote Miyan
desc: A masked man steals a package threatening India. Colonel Azad calls back his disgraced officers, Freddy and Rocky, to help. They uncover a trap in the UK.

title: Srivalli
desc: A neuroscientist joins a brain wave experiment but slowly loses track of time and reality. As things get strange, she struggles to find the truth in a mind-bending journey.

title: Kya Bolti Tu?
desc: A modern woman with a complex mind connects with a marketing executive, but complications arise when he expects the same level of love she feels for him.
